_source: Sampled from brand/Logo-4.svg (Brand Guidelines page 06 'Colors') and the logo SVG fills. Do not edit by hand — re-run scripts/extract_tokens.py against the brand pack if the brand pack changes.

typography.note: The brand pack ships no typography page. The 'Hot Bar Soldering' example deck is set in Proxima Nova (Semibold/Bold/Regular), which is the closest thing to a stated house typeface — but it is a licensed font and is not bundled here. Calibri is the safe default: it is what the STADLER example deck uses, it is present in both PowerPoint and Google Slides, and LibreOffice substitutes metric-compatible Carlito when rendering. Pass font='Proxima Nova' to Deck() to request it; if it is not installed you get a warning and the Calibri fallback rather than a silent substitution.
typography.allowed_note: Every face the brand permits, not just the deck's default. Slides transplanted verbatim from the reference template carry Montserrat and Arial legitimately; flagging those as off-brand would fire on every deck.
typography.range_note: Grounded in the company template's own slides (measured from the skeletons, char-weighted): body copy runs 13-18.7pt, card titles 15-18, slide titles 28-48; only dense data slides (team, integration) drop to 11pt, which is the floor. Authored slides must sit inside these ranges so generated content reads at the same size as the standing slides.
